visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a screen recording of a mobile phone displaying a social media thread (Threads) with comments related to workplace stress and IKEA. (2) A young man wearing a tan jacket is in a modern office setting, speaking enthusiastically to the camera while holding it in a selfie style. In the background, several colleagues sit at desks with computers, some smiling and waving as the camera pans. (3) A bright yellow screen with bold black text acts as a transition. (4) The scene shifts to a spacious, brightly lit cafeteria-style restaurant with blue walls featuring oceanic illustrations like sharks and octopuses. (5) A series of close-up shots show numerous white plates filled with various foods, prominently featuring bright red crayfish and yellow mango chunks. (6) The main character and his colleagues are seated at a long table, all wearing oversized orange paper bibs designed to look like lobsters. They are actively eating, laughing, and gesturing toward the food. (7) Close-ups focus on specific dishes, such as pasta with mango and crayfish, and a fresh salad topped with orange sauce. (8) A staff member in a blue striped uniform is shown adding mango toppings to a yellow ice cream sundae in a cup. (9) Finally, the whole group of six people, wearing the same lobster bibs and orange party hats, stands in front of an IKEA promotional poster, waving and talking directly to the camera.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a high-energy promotional vlog aimed at showcasing IKEA Taiwan's seasonal 'Crayfish Party' and mango-themed menu items. It uses a humorous 'office stress' hook to justify a team meal, then transitions into a fast-paced food review and group experience to appeal to viewers' desire for social dining and seasonal delicacies.
